- Gallery: the picture in the viewer is now shown by the zoom view the Fossify Gallery uses (Subsampling Scale Image View, Apache 2.0, taken from Maven Central). It reads only the part on the screen from the file at the sharpness the zoom needs, so a selected photo no longer stays black when opened or zoomed. The earlier own zoom code (tiles, cache) is removed. Pinch, pan, double tap and the zoom button work through it; zoom goes up to 10x. A LIVE picture plays from its chip (long press no longer starts it).
